### 
Enrolling Children
![expand](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/AccordionArrow.svg)
What is the enrolment procedure for children below the age of 5 years (Resident Indian/NRI)?
Resident Indian/NRI child seeking enrolment need to visit an Aadhaar enrolment centre along with Mother and/or Father or Legal guardian submit a request in requisite form along with valid supporting documents.
